description: Open a SEAL link. `metadata` shows the name, size, expiry, the countries it opens from and whether the sender left a message, without using an open. `file` saves each file it can to disk and returns the paths, naming in `refused` any that did not come: use it for large files, secrets and anything you pass to a program. `inline` returns small JSON, CSV or plain text into the conversation, never a secret, HTML or PDF. A link you made yourself with seal_share is not downloaded: its opens belong to the recipient.

dir.description: mode=file: the folder to save into; default ~/Downloads, created if missing. A folder you name is ~/Downloads, the working directory or a folder inside one of them, with no hidden folder on the way. An existing file is never overwritten: the new one becomes `name (1).ext`.

item.description: An inbox handle from seal_inbox (`in_…`), instead of a URL.

mode.description: `metadata` reads nothing; `file` saves to disk; `inline` returns small text.

password.description: The password of a protected seal, when the user said it in this conversation; otherwise `password_file`.

password_file.description: Path of a file whose first line is the seal's password: the path seal_request returns for kind=secret. Not together with `password`.

url.description: The full SEAL link, with everything after `#` when it has it.

name: seal_open
title: Open a SEAL link
